title: qos.dem is the only demo missing the `expect hash stable` declaration
evidence:
demos/qos.dem tail (verbatim):
  capture at 1000ms
  capture at 65000ms
(no `expect hash stable` line) — vs demos/win.dem tail (verbatim):
  capture at 2300ms
  expect hash stable
grep -c "expect hash stable" demos/*.dem: qos.dem:0, all 7 others:1. harness/demo.odin:53 `expect_hash_stable: bool,` and demo.odin:121 `d.expect_hash_stable = true` — the field is never read anywhere else (grep across all *.odin).
detail: The new era-3 golden's demo breaks the 8-demo convention; the directive is a parsed-but-dead no-op (replay gate runs unconditionally, verified green), so no gate is lost today — but the drift invites a future silent skip of the era-3 replay pin.
recommended_fix: Add `expect hash stable` to demos/qos.dem to match the other 7 demos, or remove the dead directive from all demos + the parser.
